title: Navigate to the last result in a long layer list
steps: Inspect the layer-name search showing the first of 40 matching Waypoint layers.
Click Previous once, then inspect the workspace header, toolbar, and the area below the canvas.

video_guide.summary: Navigating to the last search match leaves the workspace panels in place, with the canvas and layers extending to the bottom.

chapters.note: The Waypoint search is open with the workspace panels filling the available height.

chapters.label: Navigate to the last match with Previous

chapters.note: Navigation reaches 40 / 40 and selects the bottom canvas shape without shifting the panels upward.
The layers and canvas still extend to the bottom, with no extra empty band below them.
